verdict.rationale: GitLab's REST API docs say you can control user access programmatically to keep permissions consistent across an organization, so some organization-wide access management exists. Nothing in the pack shows how granular those roles are, or that they can be set per project, repository, branch or environment. The agent-tool Allow/Ask/Deny policies and the group-level switch for the Agent Platform are adjacent AI-governance controls and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented role/permission levels at organization (group) and project scope, branch-level controls such as protected branches, environment-level controls such as protected environments or deployment approvals, and hands-on corroboration.
